newsitem.title: USA: Alleged kidnappers will return to Michigan.
newsitem.headline: Alleged kidnappers will return to Michigan.

text.p: A federal magistrate Wednesday ordered two Michigan men charged with kidnapping two schoolgirls to be returned to Michigan to face charges.
Federal Magistrate Donald Baker denied bail for Ronald Stafford, 22, and Richard Geer, 20, and ordered U.S. marshals to return them to Michigan.
A third defendant, Lee Stafford, 17, younger brother of Ronald Stafford, was dealt with in closed juvenile hearings, but he was expected to be returned to Michigan as well.

All three were charged with kidnapping under federal statutes for grabbing Teresa and Jessica Hainer, ages 9 and 6, as they left their school bus near Kalamazoo, Mich., Friday. They were arrested in Daytona Beach Tuesday after a college student who had talked to them on the beach the day before called police.
